Segnala offerta di lavoro Bring more to life. Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Leica Microsystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. Shape the Future with Us! At Leica Microsystems, we have been shaping the future for over 175 years with groundbreaking optical and digital solutions. With a culture rooted in customer focus, innovation, and teamwork, we lead the market in microscopy, imaging, and analysis, unveiling the invisible and empowering our customers to build a better, healthier world. Joining Leica Microsystems means contributing to scientific discoveries and supporting surgeons in making critical decisions. Our advanced microscopes and AI-based image analysis solutions enable users to gain profound insights into development and engineering challenges. Here, you will work on meaningful projects alongside passionate colleagues, driving progress and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Commercial Training & Competency Program Manager is responsible for designing, deploying, and governing a global and consistent commercial capability development framework across all Regions. This role partners closely with Regional Commercial Leaders, Business Units (BUs), and DBS leaders to build a robust and scalable learning ecosystem, strengthen sales competencies, and ensure commercial teams perform at their highest potential. This role requires an experienced commercial leader with strong understanding of sales cycles and process in a B2B environment, customer engagement, and commercial excellence practices. The role is both strategic and hands-on, driving global alignment while enabling local execution. This position reports to the Director Global Commercial Operations and will be part of the Global Commercial Operations team. The position will be fully remote in Italy. In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To Develop and lead the global commercial training strategy by establishing a consistent, scalable learning framework, onboarding programs, and blended learning solutions across all regions. Build and govern a global sales competency framework that defines required capabilities, assesses proficiency, identifies gaps, and drives development plans for all commercial roles. Partner with Regional Commercial Leaders, Business Units, and DBS teams to align training priorities, ensure content relevance, and drive accountability for capability development. Establish robust training governance and operational excellence through standardized processes, content management, reporting, compliance oversight, learning platforms, and Train-the-Trainer networks. Measure impact and continuously improve commercial capabilities by tracking training effectiveness, monitoring competency progress, analyzing performance gaps, and providing actionable insights to leadership. The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Training & Development, Commercial Management, or comparable experience 7+ years in Sales, Commercial Excellence, Sales Enablement, or Training roles Demonstrated ability to build and manage global programs and projects Excellent facilitation, communication, and influencing skills Strong command of MS Office, and in particular MS Excel and large language model (LLM) based answer engines such as M365 Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements Ability to travel 20% of time It would be a plus if you also possess experience in: Working knowledge with Learning Management Systems (Cornerstone, Workday Learning) Leica Microsystems, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info. Base salary and level of employment This role is classified under the applicable CCNL Commercio as Quadro, which defines minimum terms, job classification, and baseline progression frameworks. The expected gross annual salary range for this role is €85000 - 131000, determined based on objective criteria such as experience, skills, and role-related competencies. Bonus / Incentive Pay This job is also eligible for bonus / incentive pay. This is the target earnings as 20% of base annual salary, subject to objective eligibility criteria and performance conditions as set out in the applicable scheme terms and conditions. This job is also eligible for a comprehensive package of benefits. Details regarding these benefits will be provided separately. At Leica Microsystems we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Leica Microsystems can provide. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Europe West Pursuit and Commercial Excellence Team Pursuit Strategist – Assistant Director The opportunity The Pursuit Strategist (PS) partners with account teams to support regional strategic, high-value pursuits driven out of the Europe West (EW) Region. They engage at multiple stages during the pursuit process and are responsible for developing a tailored communications strategy to articulate a compelling ‘Why EY’ proposition in all pursuit collateral. The PS is responsible for the tactical management of all pursuit work-streams including the communication campaign, draft value proposition, proposal development, facilitation of pursuit readiness sessions and orals preparation. Additionally, the PS is required to identify, develop, and implement innovative approaches to pursuit management and drive adoption of these across the EW, including the use of AI to support the pursuit process. Your Key Responsibilities Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management Partners with account teams to provide a full-service pursuit management model for EW based strategic, high-end opportunities Serves as a facilitator/key contributor in pursuit strategy sessions, manages output and drives actions Contributes to the EW repository of Country , Region, Industry or Service Line client-facing collateral as appropriate Strategic Client, Internal and External Communications Develops strategic messaging and lead conceptualisation of all client-facing pursuit collateral Manages and leads the development of opportunity value propositions Ultimately responsible for quality control of all client-facing materials during the pursuit Acts as the knowledge steward for the pursuit Administration and Reporting Leads post pursuit analysis and review; makes recommendations for process improvement Maintains relationships with other Pursuit and Commercial Excellence (P&CE) teams and key interdependency groups across the organisation Participates in relevant internal and external networks Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities Champions best-practice pursuit management tools and processes Solution-oriented and makes sound decisions quickly, given tight timeframes Demonstrates versatility in a constantly evolving environment with a wide variety of social styles Influences / challenges the account team to optimise the chances of winning Supervision Responsibilities Works with considerable autonomy while often managing the work of others Contributes to the team connectivity within the EW Pursuits community Provides coaching and mentoring to others; may serve as a Counsellor to other PS’ in the EW region Supports the onboarding and training of new hires in the EW region Develops and coaches BD and client servers, through teaming on pursuits and facilitated training Oversees the work of the pursuit support team, including any third-party resources (e.g., Pursuit Coordinator, external translation services, etc.) Other Requirements As the job involves responding to client needs and varying time zones, we would expect flexibility to accommodate these. Hybrid working available depending on local office requirements Frequent travel may be required Skills And Attributes For Success Good understanding of Business Development and Pursuit Management Excellent communications skills (written and verbal) in English is a must. To qualify for the role you must have Pursuit Management experience Experience in developing external marketing communications (necessary for Senior PS / advantageous for entry-level PS) Experience working in a cross-border, multi-cultural environment (necessary for Senior PS / advantageous for entry-level PS) Ideally, you’ll also have Ability to influence without authority, lead and coach others Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders What We Look For Excellent project management skills Ability to work independently with minimal supervision A strong communicator with a sharp pen What We Offer We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with MyReward you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings, and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer: Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build. Apply now.
